props.name: breakpoint
props.description:
Max viewport width in pixels that counts as mobile.
Used as `(max-width: ${breakpoint}px)` when `mobile` is omitted.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the element.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Initial open state. Unlike `open`, which is a plain boolean for the active layout, this
accepts `'desktop-only'` because the sidebar remembers uncontrolled state per layout:
`true` opens both layouts, `'desktop-only'` opens only the desktop panel, and `false`
closes both. When omitted, the desktop panel starts expanded and the mobile drawer starts
closed. Ignored while `open` is controlled.

props.name: defaultWidth
props.description:
Initial desktop panel width in pixels for uncontrolled usage. Ignored while `width` is
controlled. When omitted, the recipe default width applies until the rail is resized.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum desktop panel width in pixels for `Sidebar.Rail` resizing.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum desktop panel width in pixels for `Sidebar.Rail` resizing.

props.name: mobile
props.description:
Controlled mobile mode: `true` renders the panel in a drawer, `false` inline. When omitted,
a `matchMedia` query on `breakpoint` decides, and the server renders the desktop layout.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the next open state for every user-driven change of the active layout: the
trigger, the rail, and Escape or overlay dismissal of the mobile drawer. Not called when
the layout switches.

props.name: onWidthChange
props.description:
Called with the new pixel width on every width change, including each step of a
`Sidebar.Rail` drag; use `onWidthCommit` to persist only the final value.

props.name: onWidthCommit
props.description:
Called once per completed interaction with the final pixel width:
at the end of a `Sidebar.Rail` drag that changed the width, and on
each keyboard width change.

props.name: open
props.description:
Controlled open state of the active layout: the desktop panel, or the mobile drawer when
the sidebar is mobile. Switching layouts does not write this value.

props.name: side
props.description: Which viewport edge the sidebar attaches to.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description:
Localized labels for this sidebar (`label` for the mobile drawer and `resize` for the rail
separator). Merged per key over the provider messages and English defaults.
examples:
import { Sidebar } from 'moraine'

<Sidebar translations={{ label: 'Navegación', resize: 'Cambiar tamaño' }}>
  <Sidebar.Panel />
  <Sidebar.Rail />
</Sidebar>

props.name: variant
props.description: Sidebar chrome variant: `default` sits inline, `floating` and `inset` lift it from the page.

props.name: width
props.description:
Controlled desktop panel width in pixels. When `undefined` the
`--mo-sidebar-width` custom property is left unset and the recipe
default (`var(--sidebar-width, clamp(14rem, 25%, 20rem))`) applies.

the native `disabled` attribute are emitted only for a `'button'` host.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description:
Whether activating this button on mobile closes the drawer. Has no effect on desktop, when
the button is disabled, or when the click handler calls `preventDefault()`; modified and
non-primary clicks never close it. When omitted, buttons with `href` close the drawer and
others stay open.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this trigger is disabled.

props.name: href
props.description:
Link target. Makes the button render as an `<a>` (unless `as` picks another element or
component, which still receives `href`). A disabled `<a>` has its `href` removed.
